title: Drones Hit Albashneft: Satellite Images Reveal Devastation of Key Russian Facility
text:
Ukrainian Forces Strike ⁢Russian Oil Depot Using Shock Drones In a strategic move that has sent ​shockwaves through the Russian ​logistics network, the ​defense forces of‌ ukraine have successfully targeted the Albashneft ​oil depot in ⁤the Krasnodar Territory of the Russian Federation. Satellite images ​have provided a clear view of the aftermath, revealing the extent of the damage inflicted⁢ on this critical infrastructure.
The attack,⁣ which took place​ on ‌the night of February 5, 2025, was carried out using shock drones. These unmanned aerial vehicles managed to​ strike the oil ⁣depot with precision,⁤ causing important ⁣destruction. According to reports,‌ one ‌storage tank containing 60 tons of oil was wholly destroyed.​ A nearby ‍tank also sustained damage but did not catch ⁤fire.
The Albashneft ‍oil depot, located in the village of Novominskaya, is a vital​ link in the supply ⁤chain for the Russian army. It plays a⁣ crucial role in ⁣fueling the occupation forces in their ongoing war against Ukraine. The depot’s strategic importance makes it a prime target for Ukrainian military operations.
The attack was first reported by the edition‌ “Radio Liberty”‍ on February 9. The details was later confirmed ⁣by satellite⁢ imagery, providing visual evidence of the successful strike. There have been rumors suggesting that the attack ‍was not carried out by drones but by a ​new type‌ of Ukrainian winged rocket. However, these claims remain unconfirmed at this time.The Russian authorities⁣ managed ⁣to extinguish the resulting fire by 8:00 ⁣AM ‌the following morning. Fortunately,no civilians were harmed during the operation.This‍ targeted strike is​ part of a broader effort⁣ by Ukrainian forces to disrupt ⁤the russian army’s logistics⁢ and supply chains.
The ​Albashneft oil‍ depot is not the only Russian facility to come under attack‍ recently. Previously,the Novoshakhtinsky oil ⁣refinery​ in Russia was reported to have ⁤stopped⁤ operating. Additionally, drones have been used to attack​ the⁢ Rostov ⁢oil reserve under Tula,⁤ further​ highlighting the effectiveness of ⁣these unmanned aerial vehicles in military⁤ operations.
